title: Hackers tricked thousands with fake AI skills #AI #security #hack
description:
A critical AI vulnerability lets malicious skills trick you into running dangerous code on your computer.

This breakdown explains how attackers disguise harmful scripts as legitimate AI tools to bypass security scans. I demonstrate exactly how these malicious AI skills function and what you need to check before granting permissions to any new tool. Protect your personal files and systems by understanding these emerging AI security risks.

Subscribe for more practical cybersecurity breakdowns.
